name: Bulacan Marathon 2026
short_description: The Bulacan Marathon 2026 is a full-marathon race held on August 9, 2026, at SM Center Pulilan in Pulilan, Bulacan, Philippines.
ai_summary: The Bulacan Marathon 2026 is a full-marathon event scheduled for August 9, 2026, in Pulilan, Bulacan, Philippines. Hosted at SM Center Pulilan, the race offers four distance options: 42.195km, 21.1km, 10km, and 5km, catering to a range of runner abilities. It is organized by Team Malofit x Pairfect Fit, and registration is currently open.
pros: Offers multiple distance options (42.195km, 21.1km, 10km, 5km) for different runner levels
Registration is currently open, giving ample time to prepare
Convenient venue at SM Center Pulilan in Pulilan, Bulacan
research_highlights: First-ever full marathon staged by this organizer: the event is billed as an expansion of the existing Bulacan Half Marathon franchise, described as "an even bigger challenge" following "the success of the Bulacan Half Marathon and due to insistent demand from the running community" (Takbo.ph).
Four distance options are offered: 42K, 21K, 10K and 5K, based on official event listings (runph.org, BaseKM).
Race hub/start-finish is at SM Center, Pulilan, Bulacan, with the date listed as August 9, 2026 (some listings show August 8) by multiple race calendars (runph.org, BaseKM).
Early registrants get a perk: the first 1,000 42KM and first 1,500 21KM registrants are promised exclusive 'BM Vamos Socks' according to Pulilan Tourism Office event postings.
Walk-in registration is handled through Pairfect Fit's Plaridel Diversion Road location (in front of Waltermart), Monday to Saturday, 10am–6pm, per official registration info.

faqs.question: When is the Bulacan Marathon 2026 taking place?
faqs.answer: The Bulacan Marathon 2026 is scheduled to take place on August 9, 2026. This date has been confirmed for the event, which will be held in Pulilan, Bulacan, Philippines, and registration for participants is currently open ahead of race day.

faqs.question: What distances can participants choose from?
faqs.answer: Participants in the Bulacan Marathon 2026 can choose from four distance categories: a full marathon of 42.195km, a half marathon of 21.1km, a 10km race, and a 5km race, allowing runners of varying experience levels to take part in the event.

faqs.question: Where is the race held?
faqs.answer: The Bulacan Marathon 2026 is held at SM Center Pulilan, located in Pulilan, Bulacan, Philippines. This venue serves as the base for the event, which features multiple race distances including the full marathon, half marathon, 10km, and 5km categories.

faqs.question: Who is organizing the Bulacan Marathon 2026?
faqs.answer: The Bulacan Marathon 2026 is organized by Team Malofit x Pairfect Fit. They are responsible for coordinating the event, which takes place at SM Center Pulilan in Pulilan, Bulacan, Philippines, and includes full marathon, half marathon, 10km, and 5km distance options.
